703505.t: From δια- (dĭă-, “through”) + λογίζομαι (logĭ́zomai, “to count, reckon”), from λόγος (lógos, “word”) + -ίζω (-ĭ́zō).

703589.t: Morphologically from δια- (dia-) + στῆναι (stênai) + -μα (-ma), from ἵστημι (hístēmi).

703590.t: From διαστέλλω (diastéllō) + -η (-ē, abstract noun suffix), from διά (diá, “apart”) + στέλλω (stéllō, “send”).

703585.t: From διασπείρω (diaspeírō, “to sow, to scatter”) + -η (-ē, verbal noun suffix).

703531.t: δια- (dia-, “across, through”) + νόος (nóos, “mind”) + -ια (-ia, abstract noun forming suffix). Compare διανοέομαι (dianoéomai).

703517.t: From δια- (dĭă-, “across, through”) + μένω (ménō, “to stay, to remain”). Related to and synonymous with Latin permaneō.

703587.t: From διΐστημι (dĭĭ̈́stēmĭ, “separate, stand apart”) with stem as in στάσις (stắsĭs).
